shared_elements: shallow relief carving on weathered stone
horizontal band or register dividing the field
rectangular block-like incised units arranged in rows
paired/symmetrical motifs flanking a central axis
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, outline-incised relief on coarse weathered stone, combining crisp rectilinear blocks/bands with rounded ring and hooked motifs, and both organise these into stacked horizontal registers. The decisive difference is format and composition: A is a flat horizontal slab densely filled with grid-like glyph units read across, while B is a three-dimensional vertical monolith whose motifs are sparsely and symmetrically distributed about a central spine, so the correspondences remain generic rather than compositional.
